$schema: L1 Due Diligence Supabase Payload Schema v1.0
$description: Complete JSON payload schema for delivering L1 Pre-Data Room Due Diligence results from Claude to Supabase via Edge Function. Every field maps directly to data produced by the L1 skill's 13-node process.

project.$description: The top-level fund analysis record. One per submission.

fund_name.description: Full legal fund name as it appears on the submission

asset_class.description: Primary asset class. E.g., 'Energy / Credit', 'Private Equity', 'Real Assets', 'Crypto / Digital Assets'

strategy.description: Strategy description extracted from the deck. E.g., 'Event-Driven Distressed Credit with Climate Engagement'

composite_score.description: Weighted composite L1 score across all modules

score_tier.description: Recommendation tier mapped from composite_score. 85-100 = strong_advance, 70-84 = advance_with_diligence, 50-69 = review_required, <50 = decline

recommendation.description: Human-readable recommendation text. E.g., 'ADVANCE WITH DILIGENCE ITEMS'

completeness_score.description: Submission completeness percentage from Node 1 triage. Deck-only typically 55-70%, deck+DDQ 75-90%

document_type.description: Summary of what was submitted. E.g., 'Pitch Deck Only (50 pages)', 'Pitch Deck + DDQ + Executive Summary (85 pages total)'

fund_size_estimated.description: Estimated or disclosed AUM. E.g., '$150M estimated', '$500M target'

gp_entity_name.description: General partner legal entity name. E.g., 'DSC Meridian Capital LP'

domicile.description: Fund domicile jurisdiction. E.g., 'Delaware LP + Cayman feeder'

regulatory_status.description: Registration status. E.g., 'Exempt Reporting Adviser (SEC)', 'FCA Registered'

analysis_date.description: Date the L1 analysis was completed

executive_summary_narrative.description: The 2-3 sentence summary assessment paragraph from Section 1

key_strengths.description: 4-6 key strengths from the Executive Summary, each as a structured object

category.description: Bold category label. E.g., 'Experienced leadership team'

detail.description: Supporting evidence. E.g., 'Founder managed $9B AUM at Paulson; Partners have 24+ years experience'

citation_ids.description: References to research_sources entries that support this claim

key_risks.description: 4-6 key risks from the Executive Summary

red_flag_ids.description: References to red_flags entries for drill-down

market_validation_points.description: 2-3 market validation bullets from Executive Summary

conditions_for_advancement.description: Specific conditions from Section 11 that must be met before commitment

recommended_timeline.description: Timeline narrative from Section 11. E.g., '8-12 weeks to commitment stage with disciplined data room diligence'

final_assessment_narrative.description: The full synthesis narrative from Section 11

module_scores.$description: One record per analysis module. Always exactly 5 records (A-E).
module_scores.$note: Stored as separate rows, not a JSON blob, so you can query/filter/sort by module

weight.description: Weight used in composite calculation. E.g., 0.30 for 30%. All weights must sum to 1.0

confidence_rationale.description: 1-sentence explanation. E.g., '3.25-year track record with no independent verification available'

source_documents.$description: One record per uploaded file. Produced by Node 0.

document_date.description: Date of the document itself, not the upload date

quality_notes.description: Flags like 'DRAFT watermark detected', 'Stale — dated 18 months ago'

submission_quality.$description: Structured data from Node 1 triage. One record per checklist category.

document_quality_flags.$description: Six quality dimensions from Node 1. Always exactly 6 records.

assessment.description: Brief explanation. E.g., 'December 2024 presentation is current'

critical_info_gaps.$description: 5-10 specific information gaps from Node 1 triage.

gap_description.description: What's missing and why it matters

related_module.description: Which module this gap most affects

report_sections.$description: Full markdown content for each of the 13 report sections. The rich body of the report.

content.description: Full markdown body of the section. Contains inline citation markers in the format [claim text](cite:SRC_XXX) where SRC_XXX is a citation_id from research_sources. The front-end renders these as clickable accordion elements.

module_key.description: If this section corresponds to a module, reference it here for join

team_members.$description: Structured team roster from Module B (Node 3). One record per named individual.

prior_affiliations.description: List of prior firms. E.g., ['Paulson & Co', 'JP Morgan', 'DebtTraders Inc.']

verification_detail.description: What was verified and how. E.g., 'Confirmed via LinkedIn, SEC Form ADV CRD 296590, Hedge Fund Journal feature'

verification_citation_ids.description: References to research_sources entries used for verification

is_key_person.description: Flagged if this person represents key person risk

adverse_findings.description: Any adverse media, regulatory, or litigation findings. Null if clean.

performance_metrics.$description: Structured performance data from Module A (Node 2). One record per metric row.

fund_name.description: Which fund within the GP. E.g., 'Climate Action Fund' vs 'Credit Opportunities Fund'

value.description: The fund's value. String to handle mixed formats: '+30.70%', '4.1%', '2.9 years', '$1.50%'

value_numeric.description: Numeric value where parseable, for charting. E.g., 30.70, 4.1

fee_structure.$description: Structured fee terms from Modules A and D. One record per share class per fee component.

value.description: The disclosed value. E.g., '1.50% (<$500M), 1.25% ($500M-$1B)', '17.5%', '1 Year Soft (5% penalty)'

asset_class_norm.description: Typical range for this asset class. E.g., '1.0-1.5% for credit funds'

is_disclosed.description: False if this is a gap / not provided in the submission

thesis_validations.$description: Structured thesis claim validation from Module C (Node 4). One record per claim tested.

claim.description: The specific thesis claim from the deck. E.g., 'HY issuers = 3% of debt, 33% of emissions'

claim_source.description: Where in the deck this claim appears. E.g., 'Deck, Pages 4-6'

validation_detail.description: How the claim was validated and what was found

citation_ids.description: Research sources that validated or contradicted this claim

competitive_landscape.$description: Competitors identified in Module C. One record per competitor.

differentiation_vs_fund.description: How the analyzed fund differs from this competitor

competitive_assessment.description: E.g., 'Apollo can out-market but lacks specialized climate-credit thesis'

market_factors.$description: Tailwinds and headwinds from Module C. One record per factor.

supporting_data.description: Key data point. E.g., 'UNPRI signatories control ~$58T'

service_providers.$description: Service provider status from Module E (Node 6). One record per provider type.

is_verified.description: Null if not disclosed; true/false if verified via research

notes.description: E.g., 'David Gulkowitz holds CFO/COO/CCO simultaneously — concentration concern'

red_flags.$description: Aggregated red flags from Node 7. One record per flag.

flag_number.description: Sequential number within severity tier. E.g., 1, 2, 3

title.description: Descriptive title. E.g., 'Service Provider Gaps — Institutional Non-Starter'

implication.description: Why this matters for the investment decision

resolution.description: What needs to happen to address this flag

source_module.description: Which module identified this flag. E.g., 'module_b_team'

related_interrogatory_ids.description: question_ids of interrogatory items that address this flag. E.g., ['B2', 'B3']

related_data_room_ids.description: References to data_room_items that would resolve this flag

order_index.description: Global ordering: criticals first, then elevated, then monitor

interrogatory_items.$description: Questions for the GP meeting from Node 8. One record per question.

question.description: The full question text, specific to this fund

rationale.description: Why this question matters — what finding or gap prompted it

status.description: Workflow status. Updated after GP meeting.

gp_response_score.description: GP meeting response quality. 3 = clear/documented, 2 = directional, 1 = vague/deflection, 0 = non-response

gp_response_notes.description: What the GP actually said. Filled in by analyst after meeting.

related_red_flag_ids.description: flag_numbers of red flags this question addresses

data_room_items.$description: Document request checklist from Node 9. One record per document.

priority_tier.description: 1 = Deal-Breaker (required for any commitment), 2 = Essential (required pre-commitment), 3 = Supporting (full diligence), 4 = Nice-to-Have

sub_items.description: Specific sub-documents needed. E.g., ['Full document including exhibits', 'All amendments to date', 'Side letters or investor-specific terms']

research_sources.$description: All sources used in the analysis, from Node 11. The backbone of the citation system.

citation_id.description: Unique reference ID embedded in report markdown. Format: 'SRC_001', 'SRC_002', etc. This is what inline citations in report_sections.content reference via (cite:SRC_001)

title.description: Source display name. E.g., 'SEC Form ADV: DSC Meridian Capital LP (CRD 296590)'

url.description: Full URL. Null for non-web sources like 'Bloomberg terminal data'

source_category.description: Maps to the four groups in Appendix A

excerpt.description: The specific finding or data point extracted from this source. This is what renders in the accordion when an inline citation is clicked. E.g., 'Confirmed: Former Head of Credit Research at Paulson & Co. Vanderbilt MBA (2000), IIT Bombay B.Tech (1996).'

accessed_date.description: When this source was accessed during research

linked_sections.description: Which report sections cite this source. E.g., ['module_b_team', 'executive_summary']

linked_team_member_names.description: If this source relates to team verification, which team members. E.g., ['Sheru Chowdhry']

favicon_url.description: For UI display next to source links

is_primary.description: True if this is a primary/original source vs. secondary commentary

engagement_case_studies.$description: Optional. Structured engagement track record data when the fund has an engagement/ESG mandate. Extracted from Module C.

engagement_outcomes.description: List of concrete outcomes. E.g., ['Net-zero announcement June 2021', 'New Head of ESG hired']

citation_system.description: Inline citations work by embedding (cite:SRC_XXX) markers in report_sections.content markdown. The front-end matches SRC_XXX to research_sources.citation_id and renders a clickable accordion showing the source title, URL, excerpt, and accessed_date. End-of-report citations in appendix_sources section group research_sources by source_category.

cross_references.all tables → project: All tables have an implicit project_id foreign key
